notes: Batch 002 keeps Projekt as the only central case node, keeps Bewertung as a scalar, stores metrics as properties, models Stadt/Land/Bauwerk/Bauobjektrolle/Bauobjektklasse/Akteurrolle as connected nodes, and routes all BELEGT_IN relationships to the case-markdown Quelle nodes. External URLs are stored as external_sources arrays on each markdown Quelle to avoid one-edge source nodes.
